visual_brief.hero_identity: East Asian heroine with a softly defined oval face, straight dark bob with tucked ends and a neat fringe, and a mid-20s age impression. Styling stays sleek and nocturnal: smoky liner, muted lips, black zip jacket over a slim satin slip silhouette, dark jeans, and small silver hoop earrings. Signature wardrobe is the black zip jacket layered over the slip silhouette, with the silver hoops as the only hero prop accent.
visual_brief.world_rules: A rain-slick East Asian nightlife district holds the full video: storefront glass, station-edge pavement, and neon crosswalk spill all belong to the same walkable block. Image texture stays glossy, humid, and lightly hazed, with reflections, mist, and wet asphalt softening every frame. The master palette is charcoal, petrol blue, and neon red with low-key sodium and neon edge light as the baseline.
